object.name: evi_sline
object.digest: Reimplementation of MSP <o>line~</o> but with an embedded 'S-curve'
object.description: evi_sline is similar to MSP <o>line~</o> (without list processing of course) and <o>evi_line</o>, providing exact ramp destination time but with an 'S-curve' output ramp. Because the destination time is exact, this can be used for CPU management (as it is often in the evieve package).

inlets.name: ramp
inlets.digest: Amount of time the value takes to reach it's destination. evi_sline reaches it's destination exactly in this time.

outlets.name: exact
outlets.digest: Smoothed output ramp, or target value if ramp is complete.

outlets.digestauto: When Ramp Reaches Destination (0 During Ramp)
outlets.digest: 1 When Ramp Reaches Destination (0 During Ramp).
